notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Program.Logout.cs + LogoutUiLaw realize the whole arc: CMSG_LOGOUT_REQUEST on Logout/Exit, the SMSG_LOGOUT_RESPONSE decision table (reason!=0 refused with an error line and quit-disarm; instant silent awaiting completion; else a 20 s camp/quit countdown dialog), CMSG_LOGOUT_CANCEL via ESC or Cancel with SMSG_LOGOUT_CANCEL_ACK teardown, quit-only 'Exit now' force button, countdown expiry that only narrates (never manufactures completion), and SMSG_LOGOUT_COMPLETE either exiting the process (quit) or tearing down to character select. Menu sounds fire on request and dialog show/hide.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: Matches Benilla's structure including the subtle rules: quit disarmed on every terminal edge, no-session quit exits locally while no-session logout is a no-op (the reference glue-screen posture), and the local timer never sends anything at zero. The registry's 10/10 opcode hit rate is consistent with this reading.
